messages:
Tara Voss: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership publish a tiny owners + launch-window table for API / Console / Optimize so squads can lock sprint scope? :wave:

Benji Clarke: TL;DR: API hosted parity -> soft GA target 2026-07-16; Console opt-in beta -> target 2026-07-02; Optimize (cost hints + batching) -> alpha target mid-August 2026. owners below. :memo:

Iris Wang: question: do any of these depend on Dedicated rollout or on runtime telemetry being stabilized? Need explicit callouts for partners and infra.

Benji Clarke: short answer: Hosted API GA is independent of Dedicated. Optimize alpha requires stable telemetry (per-request token counts); Console beta is opt-in and non-breaking.

Oliver Park: proposed owners:
- API GA: Benji Clarke (PM) + Iris Wang (Eng lead)
- Console beta: Tara Voss (Product) + Oliver Park (DevEx)
- Optimize alpha: Samira Ali (ML infra) + Oliver Park (Product eng)
I'll create a one-page checklist and a weekly 15m sync for owners.

Samira Ali: Optimize alpha scope: initial batching recommendations + simple quantization guidance (no automated rewriters). telemetry needs: per-request token counts + model latency histograms. If telemetry slips, plan shifts by ~3w.

Tara Voss: can we get a copyable canary snippet (traffic ramp, rollback triggers, duration) for runbooks?

Iris Wang: pasted a minimal canary template to copy:
```
canary:
  steps: [1, 5, 20]
  step_days: 3
  total_days: 9
  rollback_if:
    - "5xx_rate > 0.5%"
    - "p95_latency > baseline * 1.25"
    - "client_error_rate_delta > 2%"
```
Use feature flags for Console beta.

Benji Clarke: risks: perf regressions (+2w), telemetry sampling bug (+3w), design asset backlog for Console screenshots (+1-2w). We'll flag slips in this thread.

Samira Ali: timeline commitments (targets):
- API: soft GA 2026-07-16; canary starts 2026-07-02
- Console: opt-in beta 2026-07-02; phased rollout after beta feedback starting 2026-07-22
- Optimize: alpha target 2026-08-18 (dependent on telemetry)
These are targets; weekly readiness checks will determine final shipability.

Tara Voss: please add a compact migration notes link for partners and assign a marketing liaison for release bullets.

Oliver Park: checklist v0 uploaded: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/2601112222-checklist (edit access: owners). excerpt includes owner, target, canary window, rollback triggers, docs owner, SDK notes.

Benji Clarke: action items:
- Oliver: checklist + owners by 2026-06-12
- Iris: finalize API canary + health checks by 2026-06-20
- Samira: Optimize readiness checklist by 2026-07-08
- Tara: request marketing liaison + draft release bullets by 2026-06-18
I'll schedule the weekly 15m sync. :calendar:

allhands-bot: Recording and slides: https://meet.corp/rec/2601112200 (follow-up doc link will be attached) :movie_camera:

Tara Voss: thanks everyone. flag any >10 day slips here so leadership can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
